description: Estimates what missed calls may be costing a local service business each month, using the same formula as the free calculator at https://gotolocalai.com/missed-call-calculator: missed calls a week x 4.33 weeks a month x (share of answered calls that become jobs / 100) x average job value. It is plain arithmetic on the three numbers you give it, so there is no data to go stale, and the result is a rough estimate, not a forecast. Inputs: missed_calls_per_week, avg_job_value (US dollars) and close_rate (a percent: 40 means 40%). Source: Go-To Local, https://gotolocalai.com.

avg_job_value.description: What a typical job pays the business, in US dollars. A number from 0 to 10000000.

close_rate.description: Percent of answered calls that become jobs, written as a percent: 40 means 40%. A number from 0 to 100.

missed_calls_per_week.description: Calls the business misses in a typical week, voicemails and unanswered rings included. A number from 0 to 10000.

name: missed_call_cost
title: Missed-call cost estimate
